caption: The drawing features three main objects, all in shades of brown and tan, rendered with a glossy sheen to suggest a ceramic or glass material. The largest object is a round, flat bottle with a short neck and a single handle on the upper left side. Its front surface is decorated with a detailed relief showing three hanging game animals (a rabbit, a bird, and another small animal) beneath a flap or pouch, with the engraved text "B.F. & Co. N.Y." above them. To the left of the bottle is a tall, slender vessel shown partially in profile, also brown with light tan highlights, bearing similar relief decorations along its length. Above and to the left of both vessels is a square panel that depicts a reclining dog laying next to a hunter's rifle, with detailing in similar muted brown and tan tones. The objects are arranged on a plain, off-white background with a thin rectangular outline framing them.
title: Liquor Bottle
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
